name: pods-state
question: Is a PODS session active in this project, who is on the roster, what is each worker's status, and are there open alerts / messages-to-LEAD / decisions?
cost_provenance: measured 1.8s 2026-07-02 on the ULDF framework repo under Git Bash (win32; slowest supported environment) with a live 4-worker PODS session -- declared 2500ms pessimistic-honest per ORACLE-COST-01; no lane field (project-state, consumed on demand, never in the finalize fast lane or the every-session briefing fan-out)

assertion.asserts: A PODS collaboration session is active in this project, and this is its roster, per-worker status, and set of open alerts / messages-to-LEAD / decisions.
assertion.measures: That the registry's top-level podsSession value yields a collab id (the canonical STRING form directly; the legacy dict form via its sessionId, then id, read only from inside the podsSession value itself), that .claude/collaboration/<id>/ exists as a directory, and the parse of that directory's channels/*.md under the monitor-pods parsing conventions, cross-checked for roster completeness against the independent workers/<AGENT>/ enumeration (PODSSTATUS-08).
known_gaps: OVALID / DEFER-096, the drift this declaration was added to close: until 2026-08-05 this oracle measured 'a STRING-form podsSession row exists' while asserting 'a PODS session is active', so an LD who wrote the dict form got active:false for a demonstrably live session (converge collab-20260804-230108 Phase 2). Both shapes are read now; the declaration exists so the next shape change is noticed before it ships, not after.

Liveness is DIRECTORY-and-pointer-shaped, not process-shaped: a converged-but-uncleared podsSession pointer whose session directory still exists reports active:true. No pid is probed here (that is csi_arc_conclude_eligibility's job) -- converge clearing the pointer to null is what makes this answer go false.

rosterMissing is DIRECTIONAL by design: it reports workers/ members the parser missed, never status sections with no worker directory -- the latter is the normal deferred-reviewer pattern (a PENDING roster entry never spawned), and flagging it would fire on every session that uses it.

Worker status is whatever channels/status.md SAYS. A worker that died mid-turn without updating its section reports its last written status indefinitely; the field measures the self-report, not the process.

The extractor is bounded to the podsSession value by a brace walk, so a sessions[] entry's sessionId/siblingGroup/podsWindow cannot be mistaken for the active collab -- but the walk assumes well-formed JSON. A registry truncated mid-publish can leave the object unterminated, in which case the walk consumes the remainder and the object regex may find nothing, yielding active:false (the gracefully-absent direction, never a wrong id).

schema.podsSession: string|null (collab session id; always emitted as a STRING regardless of which registry shape it was read from)
schema.agents: array of {id, role, status (UPPERCASE|null), progress (string|null), isComplete: boolean, spawned: boolean}
schema.allComplete: boolean (complete==total AND total>0 AND rosterMissing is empty -- PODSSTATUS-08/DEC-348: the denominator may not share its source with the numerator)
schema.rosterMissing: array of worker ids present as workers/<AGENT>/ but absent from the status parse (LEAD excluded). Informative, not an alarm: before a worker's first status publish it names who has not checked in yet. Non-empty forces allComplete false.

open.messagesToLead: array of OPEN QUESTION/REQUEST message ids addressed to LEAD/ALL (MSG-*)

fallback: Read .claude/collaboration/active-sessions.json top-level podsSession -- canonically a STRING collab id; if it is an object instead (legacy, machine-local registries keep it), take its sessionId or id. When non-null, read .claude/collaboration/<podsSession>/channels/status.md (agent sections '## CLAUDE-X | Role' with '**Status**:' fields; COMPLETE/COMPLETED/DONE/FINISHED all mean complete), channels/alerts.md (ACTIVE '## ALERT-*' blocks), channels/messages.md (OPEN '## MSG-*' blocks whose To: names LEAD or ALL), channels/decisions.md (OPEN '## DEC-*' blocks).

provenance.note: Scrutiny 05 ADD-3: the LD, converge Phase 2 readiness, and collab-sync re-derived this answer agentically by reading 4 files every time. Parsing contract is parity-locked to monitor-pods.{sh,ps1} parse_snapshot/scan_channel_file conventions (heading regex, colon-inside-bold Status tolerance, completion-synonym set, To: LEAD/ALL matching) -- if the monitor's parser changes, change this oracle in the same commit.
